About

Ja Ronn & FLOW

Founded in 2014 by gospel and R&B performer and instructor Ja Ronn Thompson, the ensemble has performed across the country for Quincy Jones, Oprah Winfrey, Tyler Perry, George Lucas, Journey and more, and was featured on Oxygen's “Fix My Choir” with Deitrick Haddon and Michelle Williams of Destiny's Child. Every member is in college or a college graduate — and through counseling and mentoring, the group helps its community get there too.

The director

Ja Ronn Thompson

Oakland-born, church-raised, mentored by Terrance Kelly of the Oakland Interfaith Gospel Choir; studied with Janice Maxie Reid and Allowyn Price.

Founder & director of the SF State Gospel Choir · led it to 2nd place, West Coast Region, at “How Sweet The Sound,” Staples Center · directed at George Lucas's wedding, Skywalker Ranch · workshops in Costa Rica, Ireland, and across Africa.
